## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the orange capped bottle and set it on the pad

Task description: Move the pill bottle with an orange cap and white body onto the blue square mat and release it. The mat is in front of the bottle, toward the bottom of the image.

Success criteria: The bottle is horizontally near the center of the blue square mat and resting on its surface, not suspended. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping straight bottle walls below the shoulder and above the bottom edge, fully seating both pads and leaving room for bottom contact with the mat to reduce slipping or fingertips hitting the table first.
- Match the opening to bottle width and watch clearance from the beige box to its left. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides rather than merely overlapping in the view without surrounding the body.
- Keep the bottle upright and its base off the table during transport to avoid dragging and tilting it. If adjusting the gripper orientation, do so where there is ample clearance around it.
- Lower slightly during placement and release only after the bottle base is supported by the mat, avoiding tipping or landing off the square mat due to an unsupported release.
